Profile.heading: Professional Profile
Profile.lead: My work focuses on turning ideas and needs into intuitive, accessible, and maintainable web solutions.
paragraphs: Full Stack Developer with a strong frontend and UX/UI foundation and 2+ years of experience building web applications with React, Next.js, TypeScript and Laravel. At VALIDA I built and maintained internal systems as part of a Scrum team. As a freelancer I built the frontend of a private medical platform for a healthcare client in Spain, in production with ongoing maintenance, and designed and built unda, my own scheduling SaaS, full stack with Next.js, Prisma and PostgreSQL.
Profile.seeking: Looking for a remote Full Stack (Next.js) or Frontend role.

roles.title: Full Stack Developer · Freelance
roles.context: Client projects and own products · since September 2026 under my studio ula studio (somosulastudio.com)
bullets: Developed a private internal medical management platform for a healthcare client in Spain with Laravel and Livewire: the entire frontend plus contributions to the database and backend, alongside a backend developer. In production since July 2025, with ongoing maintenance.
Designed and built unda (agendaunda.com) full stack, a scheduling SaaS: own REST API with Next.js, Prisma and PostgreSQL, session-based authentication and Zod validation. Live, in beta.
Designed and built websites and landing pages, plus the UX/UI and frontend of a multi-role appointment platform, with Next.js, TypeScript and Figma.

roles.title: Frontend Developer
bullets: Developed and maintained interfaces for internal systems with Laravel, Livewire and Tailwind CSS, building reusable components and UX/UI and accessibility (WCAG) improvements.
Worked in an agile Scrum team (sprints, dailies, planning and retrospectives), managing tasks in Jira.
Applied version control with Git and GitLab: branches, merge requests and code review.
Collaborated with backend, design and QA team members.
Contributed to technical SEO and the evolution of interface design.
